## 

```{r}
# --- 1. Load Required Libraries ---
# install.packages(c("dplyr", "tidyr", "irr"))
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(irr)

#' Run a Bootstrap Simulation for Rater Reliability
#'
#' @param df_list A list of data frames with rater data.
#' @param id_col The name of the column containing the item identifier.
#' @param ai_raters A character vector with the names of the AI raters.
#' @param n_samples The number of articles to sample for each rater per iteration.
#' @param n_iterations The total number of bootstrap iterations to run.
#'
#' @return A data frame with n_iterations rows, containing the bootstrapped
#'         average Kappa scores for intra-AI and intra-human groups.
run_bootstrap_simulation <- function(df_list,
                                     id_col,
                                     ai_raters,
                                     n_samples = 3,
                                     n_iterations = 1000) {

  # --- Data Preparation (done once) ---
  message("Preparing data...")
  combined_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_list)
  all_raters <- setdiff(names(combined_df), id_col)
  human_raters <- setdiff(all_raters, ai_raters)

  # Convert to a long format to easily find which rater rated which article
  long_df <- combined_df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(all_raters),
      names_to = "rater",
      values_to = "rating"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rating)) # Remove NAs

  # Create a list of articles rated by each person
  articles_per_rater <- long_df %>%
    group_by(rater) %>%
    summarise(articles = list(unique(.data[[id_col]])))

  # --- Helper function to calculate summary Kappas for one dataset ---
  calculate_summary_kappas <- function(data) {
    # Get all pairwise combinations of raters present in the current sample
    present_raters <- setdiff(names(data), id_col)
    rater_pairs <- combn(present_raters, 2, simplify = FALSE)
    
    kappas <- list(intra_ai = c(), intra_human = c())

    for (pair in rater_pairs) {
      r1 <- pair[1]
      r2 <- pair[2]

      # Get data for the pair and remove items not rated by both
      pair_data <- data %>%
        select(all_of(c(r1, r2))) %>%
        na.omit()

      # Kappa requires at least 2 valid comparisons
      if (nrow(pair_data) > 1) {
        # Using "squared" weights for Weighted Kappa, suitable for ordinal scales
        kappa_val <- irr::kappa2(pair_data, weight = "squared")$value

        # Classify and store the kappa value
        if (r1 %in% ai_raters && r2 %in% ai_raters) {
          kappas$intra_ai <- c(kappas$intra_ai, kappa_val)
        } else if (r1 %in% human_raters && r2 %in% human_raters) {
          kappas$intra_human <- c(kappas$intra_human, kappa_val)
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Return the mean kappa for each group, using NA if no pairs were found
    return(
      data.frame(
        intra_ai_kappa = ifelse(length(kappas$intra_ai) > 0, mean(kappas$intra_ai), NA),
        intra_human_kappa = ifelse(length(kappas$intra_human) > 0, mean(kappas$intra_human), NA)
      )
    )
  }

  # --- Main Bootstrap Loop ---
  message(paste("Running", n_iterations, "bootstrap iterations..."))
  
  # Set up progress bar
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_iterations, style = 3)
  
  results_list <- list() # To store results from each iteration

  for (i in 1:n_iterations) {
    # For each rater, sample n_samples articles *with replacement*
    # This is the core of the bootstrap method
    sampled_article_ids <- articles_per_rater %>%
      # Ensure we don't try to sample more articles than a rater has
      mutate(n_to_sample = pmin(n_samples, length(articles))) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      summarise(sampled_ids = list(sample(articles, n_to_sample, replace = TRUE))) %>%
      pull(sampled_ids) %>%
      unlist() %>%
      unique()

    # Create the temporary dataset for this iteration
    temp_df <- combined_df %>%
      filter(.data[[id_col]] %in% sampled_article_ids)
      
    # Calculate and store metrics
    results_list[[i]] <- calculate_summary_kappas(temp_df)
    
    setTxtProgressBar(pb, i) # Update progress bar
  }
  
  close(pb) # Close progress bar
  
  # Combine all results into a single data frame
  return(dplyr::bind_rows(results_list))
}
```

```{r}

ai_raters <- c("GG", "AC", "OC")
bootstrap_results <- run_bootstrap_simulation(
  df_list = alldata,
  id_col = "Number",
  ai_raters = ai_raters,
  n_samples = 3,
  n_iterations = 1000
)

summary(bootstrap_results)
```

```{r}
ci_ai <- quantile(bootstrap_results$intra_ai_kappa, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
ci_human <- quantile(bootstrap_results$intra_human_kappa, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("95% Confidence Interval for Intra-AI Kappa:", round(ci_ai, 3), "\n")
cat("95% Confidence Interval for Intra-Human Kappa:", round(ci_human, 3), "\n")

```

```{r}
# --- 5. (Optional) Visualize the Distributions ---
# install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)

# Reshape data for plotting
plot_data <- bootstrap_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "group", values_to = "kappa")

# Create density plots
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = kappa, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("intra_ai_kappa" = "skyblue", "intra_human_kappa" = "salmon"),
    labels = c("Intra-AI", "Intra-Human")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distributions of Rater Reliability",
    subtitle = "Comparing Intra-AI and Intra-Human Weighted Kappa Scores",
    x = "Average Weighted Kappa",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Rater Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
